common_account_reset_failed: This Account could not be reset
common_internal_tools_scope: These act on the Account signed in as {email} and reach nothing of anyone else's. Another tester signed in as themselves is unaffected.
common_onboarding_mock_description: The onboarding flow against its in-page mock, reaching no Server.
common_reboard_confirm_description: Your Agents, Computers and messaging connections all stay. Onboarding opens again from the Agent you already have.
common_reboard_description: Opens onboarding again and keeps everything: Agents, Computers and messaging connections all stay. Because an Agent still exists, this walks the resume path rather than the first-run one.
common_reset_all_confirm_description: This deletes your current Agents and disconnects your Computers and messaging connections on staging. Nobody else's Account is touched.
common_reset_all_description: Returns this Account to a genuine first-run state: its Agents are deleted and its Computer access revoked. Use it to test the create path — the next run needs a fresh Computer connect command.
